info.title: VEXReach Backend API
info.description: Backend Vulnerability Intelligence API distinguishing vulnerable dependency presence, candidate symbols, static call paths, runtime observations, and OpenVEX policy.

schema.title: Response Get Assessment Api V1 Assessments  Assessment Id  Get
Response Get Openvex Document Api V1 Assessments  Assessment Id  Openvex Get
Response Get Assessment History Api V1 Assessments  Assessment Id  History Get
Response List Integrations Api V1 Integrations Get
Response List Audit Logs Api V1 Audit Logs Get

AnalysisDiagnostic.title: AnalysisDiagnostic
AnalysisDiagnostic.description: Structured diagnostic explaining analysis limitations, errors, or truncation.

AttackPathRecord.title: AttackPathRecord
AttackPathRecord.description: Explainable end-to-end attack path linking exposure, data flow, barriers, and sink.

AttackPathReport.title: AttackPathReport
AttackPathReport.description: Aggregate Attack Path Intelligence findings for an assessed Python repository.

BarrierEvidence.title: BarrierEvidence
BarrierEvidence.description: Authentication, authorization, or validation guard observed along a path.

CallGraphEdge.title: CallGraphEdge
CallGraphEdge.description: Directed call edge with provenance and all observed source call sites.

CandidateVulnerableSymbol.title: CandidateVulnerableSymbol
CandidateVulnerableSymbol.description: A single candidate vulnerable symbol targeted by static reachability analysis.

ContinuousReassessmentPlan.title: ContinuousReassessmentPlan
ContinuousReassessmentPlan.description: Targeted reassessment plan computed from evidence drift without redundant full scans.

DataFlowStep.title: DataFlowStep
DataFlowStep.description: Single tracked variable or parameter flow step along a call path.

DependencyScope.title: DependencyScope
DependencyScope.description: Relationship of a package to the application root.

DependencySymbolResolutionStatus.title: DependencySymbolResolutionStatus
DependencySymbolResolutionStatus.description: Resolution status of a candidate vulnerable symbol in dependency metadata/sources.

EntryPoint.title: EntryPoint
EntryPoint.description: Identified application entry point used as a traversal root.

EvidenceCompletenessReport.title: EvidenceCompletenessReport
EvidenceCompletenessReport.description: Explicit completeness gate inputs constraining VEX policy conclusions.

InputSourceRecord.title: InputSourceRecord
InputSourceRecord.description: External or caller-controlled input entering an entry point.

IntegrationDescriptor.title: IntegrationDescriptor
IntegrationDescriptor.description: Machine-readable status and capability contract for an external integration.

@id.title: @Id
@id.description: Unique IRI identifying this OpenVEX document

OpenVEXPolicyReport.title: OpenVEXPolicyReport
OpenVEXPolicyReport.description: Complete Evidence Aggregation, Policy Evaluation, and OpenVEX emission audit record.

package_id.title: Package Id
package_id.description: Deterministic canonical identifier unique within an assessment

version.title: Version
version.description: Installed package version, or None if unreported

ecosystem.title: Ecosystem
ecosystem.description: Normalized ecosystem name (pypi, golang, npm, cargo, unknown, etc.)

purl.title: Purl
purl.description: Package URL (PURL) if available from SBOM or scanner

dependency_scope.description: Whether dependency is direct, transitive, or unknown

source_metadata.title: Source Metadata
source_metadata.description: Raw provenance attributes (e.g., manifest location, bom-ref, pkg type)

PackageRecord.title: PackageRecord
PackageRecord.description: Normalized software component discovered in the target.

PackageUpgradeProposal.title: PackageUpgradeProposal
PackageUpgradeProposal.description: Proposed dependency version upgrade to simulate in What-If engine.

ReachabilityPath.title: ReachabilityPath
ReachabilityPath.description: Concrete static call path from an entry point to a target symbol with supporting edges.

reachable.title: Reachable
reachable.description: True if static path found, False if none in supported subset, None if unresolved/incomplete/missing

ReachabilityResult.title: ReachabilityResult
ReachabilityResult.description: Per-(vulnerability, package, candidate symbol) static reachability assessment.

ReachabilityState.title: ReachabilityState
ReachabilityState.description: Explicit static reachability outcomes preserving scope and uncertainty.

ReassessmentTriggerType.title: ReassessmentTriggerType
ReassessmentTriggerType.description: Detected change trigger requiring targeted re-evaluation.

RiskIntelligenceReport.title: RiskIntelligenceReport
RiskIntelligenceReport.description: Assessment-wide Risk Intelligence summary ranked by priority score.

RiskPriorityTier.title: RiskPriorityTier
RiskPriorityTier.description: Explainable remediation priority buckets (not exploitability verdicts).

RuntimeEvidenceReport.title: RuntimeEvidenceReport
RuntimeEvidenceReport.description: Runtime execution trace ingestion report explicitly recording coverage gaps.

RuntimeObservationInput.title: RuntimeObservationInput
RuntimeObservationInput.description: REST JSON payload for submitting runtime trace observations.

RuntimeObservationRecord.title: RuntimeObservationRecord
RuntimeObservationRecord.description: Confirmed function-level runtime trace observation correlated with workload identity.

ScoreFactorContribution.title: ScoreFactorContribution
ScoreFactorContribution.description: Single deterministic factor contribution to a contextual risk score.

SimulatedVulnerabilityDelta.title: SimulatedVulnerabilityDelta
SimulatedVulnerabilityDelta.description: Projected before/after status change for a single vulnerability upon dependency upgrade.

StaticReachabilityReport.title: StaticReachabilityReport
StaticReachabilityReport.description: Complete Python static reachability analysis output for a target repository.

SymbolConfidence.title: SymbolConfidence
SymbolConfidence.description: Confidence tier of a candidate vulnerable symbol.

SymbolEvidence.title: SymbolEvidence
SymbolEvidence.description: Provenance record backing a candidate vulnerable symbol.

SymbolSource.title: SymbolSource
SymbolSource.description: Origin of a candidate vulnerable symbol assertion.

TaintFlowStatus.title: TaintFlowStatus
TaintFlowStatus.description: Conservative classification distinguishing static call path from data-flow proof.

ThreatIntelligenceSignals.title: ThreatIntelligenceSignals
ThreatIntelligenceSignals.description: Retrieved external exploitation signals (EPSS and CISA KEV).

UnresolvedCall.title: UnresolvedCall
UnresolvedCall.description: Call expression or dynamic dispatch construct that could not be statically resolved.

VEXJustification.title: VEXJustification
VEXJustification.description: OpenVEX defined justification values for 'not_affected' status.

VEXPolicyDecision.title: VEXPolicyDecision
VEXPolicyDecision.description: Auditable deterministic policy decision explaining one OpenVEX statement.

vulnerability.title: Vulnerability
vulnerability.description: Object with 'name' (and optional '@id', 'description', 'aliases') identifying the CVE

products.title: Products
products.description: Identifiers (PURL strings or {'@id': ...} objects) of target products

VEXStatement.title: VEXStatement
VEXStatement.description: An individual OpenVEX 0.2.0 statement asserting vulnerability status for a product.

VulnerabilityNonConflatedView.title: VulnerabilityNonConflatedView
VulnerabilityNonConflatedView.description: Strict non-conflated view preserving distinct security assessment states.

score_note.title: Score Note
score_note.default: Deterministic remediation priority score [0-100]; NOT a mathematical probability of exploitation.

VulnerabilityRiskAssessment.title: VulnerabilityRiskAssessment
VulnerabilityRiskAssessment.description: Explainable risk assessment preserving separation between security facts and score.

WhatIfSimulationReport.title: WhatIfSimulationReport
WhatIfSimulationReport.description: Remediation impact report explicitly requiring isolated test verification.

WorkloadContext.title: WorkloadContext
WorkloadContext.description: Deployment environment metadata influencing contextual remediation priority.
